thread:
rachel: Quick experiment proposal FastStart: tiny webinar + credit path to drive immediate API activity. Offer: 700 tokens at signup + 300 bonus for attendees. Demo 12m, Q&A 8m. KPI: +14% first-api-call within 72h.

omar: sounds doable. timeline? we can spin landing + claim flow in 3 days if devs slot in.

priya: copy idea: short subject lines only. A: "Try Redwood FastStart  1,000 tokens" vs B: "Run a prompt in 1 click (free tokens)". we'll test which drives run rate.

enzo: UX: registrants get 700 automatically. attendees see a small modal to claim 300. include a tiny runnable snippet in the modal so they can run immediately.

carla: agree. also add a "Run sample prompt" button pre-filled with a 1-liner dev prompt: "Extract key tasks from this meeting notes:" to reduce friction.

rachel: growth suggestion: allocate $2k to Twitter devs + GH placements. organic via product newsletter. growth-bot any channel recs?

growth-bot: recommend Twitter devs, GitHub sponsors placements, and small Reddit dev buys. estimated CPL: $6-$10.

omar: instrumentation: landing needs cohort param + claim event. snippet: `?utm_source={{channel}}&utm_campaign=faststart_0701&cohort={{cohort}}`. devs will add canary flag.

analytics-bot: New events queued: `faststart_registrant`, `faststart_attendee`, `faststart_credit_claim`, `faststart_first_api_call`. include utm_campaign, cohort, variant. dashboard tile request accepted.

priya: creative brief: 1 hero, 3 social variations (launch, reminder, highlight), 2 email templates, and a 4-prompt starter pack (summarize, refactor, extract, embed-search). Tone: straightforward, code-first.

enzo: privacy note: credits valid on hosted API only. add line on landing + claim modal: "Hosted API credits only; contact AE for Private deployments."

rachel: can we also add an activation nudge flow: if user claims but doesn't call API in 48h, trigger an in-app toast + email with direct "Run sample prompt" link that executes once? reduces drop-off.

carla: small UX ask: claim modal should pre-populate an API key placeholder and a copyable snippet for Python + JS. minimal friction.

omar: dev ETA: landing + modal + events by Wed AM. will include cohort variants A/B and canary 20%. PR will be linked.

priya: subject split: send variant B to 30% and A to 70% so we favor the higher-conversion hypothesis.

growth-bot: noted. scheduling: creative by Mon EOD, landing Wed AM, ads Wed PM, webinar Thu 11am PT.

analytics-bot: funnel metrics to track: registrant->attendee, attendee->claim, claim->first_call(24h/72h), tokens used first session. will surface cohort comparison.

rachel: final asks: design to keep imagery dev-focused (code snippets + console screenshots). Sophie from ops to book Zoom and handle recording. ops-bot can you create preview?

ops-bot: Preview created: https://preview.redwood.app/faststart-0701 (expires 48h).

enzo: PR link when ready: `git.internal/redwood/marketing/faststart-0701`. I'll drop the branch link in here when it's ready.

rachel: action owners recap: priya=copy + subject variants, enzo=landing + modal, carla=prompt pack + UX, omar=growth buys + audience, analytics-bot=dashboard. We'll do a Fri quick go/no-go. :eyes:
